source_title: Bulletin 194, November 27, 2012: Credit Life and Accident and Health Rates
summary: Bulletin 194 increased the credit life monthly outstanding balance rates by 9%, to $0.65 (single) and $1.09 (joint) per month per $1,000. The bulletin writes the joint rate as 'One dollar ($1.09)'; the figure $1.09 is used, as confirmed by Bulletin 222. The bulletin states no effective date; the date shown is the bulletin date.
